title: Sections on an affine open in a scheme-theoretic fibre
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ a morphism of schemes [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let $U$ be any affine open of $X$, put $A=\Gamma(X,U)$, and give $A$ its $R$-algebra structure via the induced ring map $\rho:R\to A$. For every prime $p\in\operatorname{Spec}R$, write $\kappa(p)$ for its residue field [def-weil-residue-field] and $i:X_p\to X$ for the scheme-theoretic fibre inclusion [def-pc-fibre-product]. There is a ring isomorphism $e:\Gamma(X_p,i^{-1}U)\xrightarrow{\sim}A\otimes_R\kappa(p)$ satisfying $e(i^*a)=a\otimes1$ for every $a\in A$. No domain, finiteness, flatness, reducedness or nonemptiness hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Paste the pullback square for restriction of the fibre inclusion to U with the defining fibre square. In Lean use isPullback_morphismRestrict and IsPullback.paste_horiz, with flips. This identifies the open inverse image with the pullback of U and Spec of the scheme residue field over Spec R.

Apply isPushout_appTop_of_isPullback to this square: all three schemes at the base corners are affine. Transport the pushout by the global-section isomorphisms U.topIso, V.topIso and Scheme.ΓSpecIso, and by Scheme.Spec.residueFieldIso. The four transported edges are the specified R-algebra map to A, the residue-field algebra map, restriction from A to fibre sections, and the second-projection map. Check the first edge by appLE and functoriality, the second by map_residueFieldIso_inv_eq_fromSpecResidueField and ΓSpecIso_naturality, the third by resLE_app_top and appLE_eq_app, and the fourth by cancellation of an isomorphism.

Compare this transported pushout with CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct by IsPushout.isoIsPushout. The induced ring equivalence is e. Its inl_isoIsPushout_hom equation, evaluated at a, says exactly e(i^*a)=a tensor 1. No choice from an unproved existence statement is used. For empty U both section and tensor rings are zero, and the same pushout argument applies.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_fibre_sections_tensor {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of R)) (U : X.affineOpens) (p : PrimeSpectrum R) :
    let ρ := (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv ≫ f.appLE ⊤ U.1 le_top
    let _ : Algebra R Γ(X, U.1) := ρ.hom.toAlgebra
    ∃ e : Γ(f.fiber p, (f.fiberι p) ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) ≃+*
        (Γ(X, U.1) ⊗[R] p.asIdeal.ResidueField),
      ∀ a : Γ(X, U.1), e ((f.fiberι p).app U.1 a) =
        TensorProduct.tmul R a 1
